# Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS)

> CSIS is a bipartisan think tank providing research, analysis, and policy expertise on global security, international relations, and strategic affairs.

CSIS operates as a premier research institution analyzing geopolitical developments, regional conflicts, and defense policy through multiple specialized programs and regional centers. The organization engages policymakers, congressional leaders, and international audiences through events, publications, multimedia content, and expert commentary.

## Key Topics

- Geopolitics and International Relations
- National Security and Defense
- Regional Analysis (Asia, Middle East, Americas)
- Russia and Ukraine
- China Policy
- Iran and Middle East Security
- Energy Security and Climate Change
- Critical Minerals
- Aerospace and Defense
- Foreign Policy Analysis
- Congressional Engagement
- Strategic Foresight
- Expert Commentary
- Policy Research
- International Affairs

## Core Research & Analysis

- [CSIS Analysis | International Studies & Foreign Relations](https://www.csis.org/analysis): Hub for CSIS analysis on global regions and foreign policy topics
- [CSIS Programs | Center for Strategic & International Studies](https://www.csis.org/programs): Directory of CSIS research programs on security and international affairs
- [Global Regional Analysis on International Affairs | CSIS](https://www.csis.org/regions): CSIS analysis organized by global regions and geopolitical areas
- [Topics on International Relations & Foreign Policy | CSIS](https://www.csis.org/topics): Directory of CSIS research topics in international relations
- [Hess Center for New Frontiers | CSIS](https://www.csis.org/programs/hess-center-new-frontiers): CSIS foresight and scenario planning center for strategic leaders
